content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a fully operational online store using the COREMERCH infrastructure. Start by deploying a Sovereign Starter Stack, which combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic cryptocurrency payment processing. This stack allows you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including stablecoins like USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. With this, you can immediately offer your digital products to a global audience, bypassing local payment barriers.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The minimum viable stack consists of GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination ensures that you can host your digital products, manage orders, and receive payments without incurring hefty fees or dealing with the limitations of traditional payment gateways. The Sovereign Starter Stack is priced at $97 and is deployable in 48 hours, allowing you to set up an efficient sales channel without unnecessary complexity.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what is essential: establishing your infrastructure and product offerings. You don’t need to worry about intricate marketing strategies or complex website designs initially. Concentrate on loading your first three products into the system and ensuring that your payment setup is functional. Once your store is operational, you can refine your marketing approach to attract customers. This streamlined focus prevents unnecessary delays and allows for immediate revenue generation.
Blockchain payments eliminate the need for traditional banking access.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, ensure you have your products uploaded and payment processing configured with NOWPayments. Test the payment flow using a small transaction in USDT or another supported cryptocurrency to confirm that everything functions correctly. With Binance P2P supporting local currencies like the Ethiopian birr, you can easily convert your earnings into the local currency if needed. This direct approach enables you to start receiving payments within minutes, further enhancing your sales capabilities.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, take action by completing your store setup. Start by deploying your Sovereign Starter Stack and uploading your digital products. Configure your payment processing through NOWPayments and run a test transaction. Additionally, explore the Complete Builder Kit, which provides you with six blueprints and seven templates to enhance your infrastructure further. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started. Prioritize these steps to ensure that your online store is ready for sales.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
With NOWPayments, transactions are fast, secure, and efficient.

If you're looking to expand your capabilities, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It offers all six blueprints and seven templates needed to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack. This comprehensive resource equips you with everything necessary to overcome payment barriers and enhance your online presence.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.

Kenyan creators can utilize NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. It offers low fees and fast processing times, making it an ideal choice for digital product sales.

Absolutely. By using the COREMERCH infrastructure, Ethiopian creators can set up a complete online store and accept payments through cryptocurrencies without relying on Stripe or other conventional platforms.
